newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS AND BAT V SRI LANKA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS AND BAT V SRI LANKA.

text.p: Pakistan's skipper Rameez Raja won the toss and elected to bat in a four-nation Independence Cup cricket tournament match against Sri Lanka on Monday.

Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Maravan Atapattu, Aravinda de Silva, Roshan Mahanama, Hashan Tillekeratne, Chaminda Vass, Kumara Dharmasena, Muttiah Muralitharan, Sanjeeva de Silva.
Pakistan: Rameez Raja (captain), Saeed Anwar, Shahid Afridi, Ijaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Moin Khan, Azhar Mahmood, Saqlain Mushtaq, Mohammed Hussain, Aaqib Javed.
